block_audit.policy: Data and register operations retain order. Eligible DMA groups retain their final completion token on every physical input/output channel; earlier same-channel tokens/waits are removed only after checked one-to-one matching and descriptor-lifetime validation. Original group boundaries and absolute BO addresses/aliases are preserved.

body_audit.contract: All 16 layers append K/V. Last-layer outputs and logits are unused for a nonfinal chunk. Final chunk always executes the complete graph.
